winning_hook_formulas: The 'Stop/Warning' Formula: [Negative Action] + [Specific Financial Metric/Level] + [Consequence] (e.g., 'Stop buying Nifty dips before you check this 23600 level')

script_directives: Keep total duration strictly between 20-22 seconds to maintain high completion rates.
Eliminate jargon-heavy explanations; replace complex financial mechanics with 'Wealth Erosion' or 'Purchasing Power' narratives.
Front-load the 'Why' in the first 3 seconds and provide a singular, actionable 'What to do instead' in the final 5 seconds.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, negative-emotion keywords in the title (e.g., Trap, Warning, Stop, Losing) to trigger curiosity.
Limit hashtags to 3 highly relevant tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia #PersonalFinance #Investing) to keep the caption clean and algorithm-friendly.
